title: Can an Agent Rethink What It Knows? Selective Scene Memory Updates in a Changing World
abstract: arXiv:2611.19227v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Task configurations in factories, warehouses, and everyday physical environments change over time. Physical AI systems therefore need to incorporate new facts into scene memory while preserving valid information about equipment, objects, and operating constraints. We study updates to this parametric semantic-memory layer and present a joint evaluation of correction and preservation under finite update budgets. At fixed current fact count and memory parameter count, the protocol combines independent single-fact updates, budget trajectories, old-to-new answer diagnostics, and first stable success. Using a frozen 4B language model with late-layer LoRA, we evaluate seven preparation conditions and six update budgets on four-field synthetic semantic configurations. translated_title: 智能体能否重新审视它所知道的知识？变化世界中的选择性场景记忆更新
translated_abstract: 工厂、仓库和日常物理环境中的任务配置会随时间变化。因此，物理AI系统需要在向场景记忆中纳入新事实的同时，保留关于设备、物体和运行约束的有效信息。我们研究了对这一参数化语义记忆层的更新，并在有限更新预算下对纠正与保留能力进行了联合评估。在当前事实数量与记忆参数数量固定的条件下，该评估协议结合了独立的单事实更新、预算轨迹、旧答案到新答案的诊断以及首次稳定成功等要素。我们使用冻结的4B语言模型并在其后期层应用LoRA，在四字段合成语义配置上评估了七种准备条件和六种更新预算。在两种曝光匹配的历史条件下，将更新预算从8次增加到32次，可使联合成功率分别从6.25%提升至94.79%和91.15%，同时精确过时……
tldr: 该论文提出了在有限更新预算下对参数化场景语义记忆进行“纠正与保留”联合评估的协议，并证明在冻结的4B语言模型上，将更新预算从8次增加到32次可显著提升联合成功率（从6.25%提升至约94%–91%）。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a joint evaluation protocol for selective correction and preservation of parametric scene semantic memory under finite update budgets, showing that increasing the budget from 8 to 32 updates boosts a frozen 4B LLM's joint success from 6.25% to about 91–94%.
